result.markdown: --- title: "Lars Schöbitz" subtitle: "Open Science Specialist · ETH Zurich" image: assets/profile-lars-schoebitz.jpg about: template: trestles image-shape: round links: - icon: envelope text: Email href: mailto:lars@lse.de - text: Website href: https://www.lse.de - text: ORCID href: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2196-5015 - icon: github text: GitHub href: https://github.com/larnsce - icon: linkedin text: LinkedIn href: https://www.linkedin.com/in/larsschoebitz format: html: toc: false --- Environmental engineer and data scientist working in the global water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) sector. Open Science Specialist at ETH Zurich, where I help researchers make their work reproducible and their data open. I founded and lead openwashdata, teach data science with R, and write and manage the grants that fund this work. At ETH Zurich's [Global Health Engineering](https://ghe.ethz.ch) group I founded and lead [openwashdata](https://openwashdata.org), a global community that publishes WASH-sector data as documented, FAIR R packages. I wrote and manage a portfolio of ETH Board Open Research Data grants behind this work, and in 2024 openwashdata received the [National Prize for Open Research Data](https://mavt.ethz.ch/news-and-events/d-mavt-news/2024/12/national-prize-for-open-research-data.html). I am a data steward in ETH's Data Stewardship Network and the local node leader for the Swiss Reproducibility Network at ETH. I also teach data science with R and Quarto, from graduate courses at ETH Zurich and CU Boulder to free online cohorts (ds4owd) reaching hundreds of participants worldwide, and I build the R tooling ([washr](https://openwashdata.github.io/washr/), [fairenough](https://openwashdata.github.io/fairenough/), [jmpwashdata](https://github.com/larnsce/jmpwashdata)) that makes open data easier to publish. My background is in environmental and hygiene engineering, with field research on city-wide sanitation and faecal sludge management across Uganda, Tanzania, Vietnam, Bangladesh, India, Bhutan, Haiti and South Africa. ::: {.callout-note .upcoming-box title="Upcoming talks and workshops" appearance="simple" icon=false} - **November 2026** Talk [Embedded data stewardship and research intelligence: five years of practice at a research group at ETH Zurich](https://github.com/larnsce/rdc-2026). Swiss Research Data Conference (RDC 2026) - SRDSN - **November 2026** Workshop [Git for Scientists: hands-on workshop](https://github.com/larnsce/rdc-2026).
